impact: Sticky tariffs keep goods inflation elevated, adding to the case for a December Fed hike that weighs on growth holdings like NBIS, PLTR and BE; import-heavy hardware supply chains for SKM and NOK also stay under cost pressure.
summary: The White House said it will press ahead with its tariff policy days after Republicans lost ground in the midterms over rising prices, with a senior official defending the tariffs at a Chamber of Commerce summit. A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Tuesday found 62% of Americans support repealing the tariffs, as October CPI showed prices up 0.4%.
title: White House vows to keep tariffs despite midterm backlash over prices
